blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to give, to impart; to attach
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: скрыва́ть — to hide, to conceal; раскрыва́ть — to open; расстава́ться — to part, to separate; придава́ть — to give, to impart; to attach.
**сознава́ть** — to realize, to see. Wiktionary: созна́ть + -ва́ть.
**овладева́ть** — to seize, to capture, to become the owner of. Wiktionary: овладе́ть + -ва́ть.
**налива́ть** — to pour (liquid into a container). Wiktionary: нали́ть + -ва́ть.
